title: Deployment
explain: Deploying means putting your app on a server so other people can use it. Keep secrets like API keys in environment variables, never in your code. Hosts such as Render, Railway or Fly.io can run a Python web app straight from a GitHub repository.
code:
import os

API_KEY = os.environ.get("API_KEY")
PORT = int(os.environ.get("PORT", 8000))

if not API_KEY:
    raise SystemExit("Set API_KEY before starting the app")

print(f"Starting on port {PORT}")
exercise: Move a hard-coded password from your code into an environment variable and read it with `os.environ`. Add the variable name to a `.env.example` file.
tip: Never commit secrets to Git. Once a key is in the history, treat it as leaked and create a new one.
